GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.7 (3 Feb 46) CIS
(SCAPIN - 695)
APO 500
3 February 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Burmese Individuals.
1. The Imperial Japanese Government will immediately apprehend and deliver into custody of the authorities at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp)
a. Kho Khin
b. Maung Gyi
Who were formerly connected with the Burmese Embassy in Tokyo.
2. Last reported addresses of the two men were respectively:
a. 312,3 Chome, Kita-Shinagawa, Tokyo.
b. On-Shi, Gumma Ken.
3. If the Imperial Japanese Government is unable to apprehend these individuals a detailed report of their whereabouts and the reason for non-arrest will be made immediately to this headquarters.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
